summary: You can want change and still panic when it finally stops asking permission.
body: You can want change and still panic when it finally stops asking permission. When Uranus squares Chiron, an overdue disruption can remove a familiar source of control before you have replaced what it was doing for you, making the old arrangement look safer the moment it is no longer available. That reaction does not automatically mean you made the wrong turn. It may mean the protection disappeared before the support was rebuilt. Figure out what the old setup gave you besides restriction, then build that into what comes next instead of restoring the exact problem just to make the fear quieter.
